prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1455; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at a signalized intersection involving your insured. Our client sustained significant injuries as a result of the collision and is pursuing a claim for damages. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you confirm in writing the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, including any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also provide a copy of the declarations page.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes, without limitation, the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle telematics or event data recorder information, repair estimates, adjuster notes, and any dashcam or surveillance footage. Failure to preserve such material may result in sanctions. Please acknowledge receipt of this letter and confirm your preservation obligations.
